description: Amends Brighton Concept Plan for local road reconfiguration.
Adds about seven residential lots in Brighton.
Reconfigures municipal reserve land without area change.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer questioned funding for a future pedestrian rail crossing.
Funding for a future pedestrian rail crossing remains unclear.
No public responses or speakers on the amendment.
Staff offered to report back on pedestrian rail crossing funding.

description: Proposes rezoning an Aspen Ridge site near Henry Dayday Road.
Changes zoning from Future Urban Development to RMTN1.
Allows medium-density townhouses and dwelling groups.

chips.text: Residents near Faragazi Boulevard are affected by the proposed rezoning.
One public comment raised concerns about parking, park space, and ownership type.

description: Authorizes borrowing up to $923,900 for Access Transit buses.
Allows a 10% variance on the approved borrowing amount.

chips.text: Supports Access Transit, serving residents with mobility challenges.
